name: Circle Gateway (Nanopayments)
summary: Unified USDC balance across chains with instant cross-chain minting; Gateway Nanopayments enable gasless sub-cent USDC micropayments via x402.
description: Per Circle's docs: deposit USDC to non-custodial Gateway Wallet contracts and mint on any supported destination chain in under 500 ms with one API call; permissionless with no sign-up. Nanopayments go down to $0.000001 using x402 and batched settlement.
